'''Imperial Remandation Order 421BX72''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] law that permitted a [[Imperial Military/Legends|military officer]] to use any and all means necessary to apprehend a known criminal.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Seregar Turnabout|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
